g.title: CIN_QSP
g.text: Chemotherapy-Induced Neutropenia and Febrile Neutropenia — QSP Mechanistic Map
Cytotoxic exposure → cell-cycle-dependent kill of granulocytic progenitors → maturation DELAY LINE → ANC nadir
→ loss of defence at a drug-breached mucosal barrier → febrile neutropenia → dose delay / reduction → relative dose intensity → tumour control
The transit time sets WHEN the nadir arrives; the exposure sets HOW DEEP it is. G-CSF moves the first, not the second.

g.title: cluster_pk
g.text: 1. Cytotoxic PK — exposure is the only thing the drug contributes

g.title: cluster_cycle
g.text: 3. Cell cycle and DNA damage — only CYCLING cells are killed, which is why G1 arrest protects

g.title: cluster_pgx
g.text: 2. Determinants of exposure — the same dose is not the same drug

g.title: cluster_marrow
g.text: 4. Marrow — the maturation chain is a PURE DELAY (MTT ≈ 89 h); its length sets the nadir DAY

g.title: cluster_kinetics
g.text: 5. Blood and tissue kinetics — three pools, and only one of them is measured

g.title: cluster_function
g.text: 6. Neutrophil FUNCTION — a separate state, because the count can rise while defence falls

g.title: cluster_gcsf
g.text: 7. G-CSF axis — target-mediated clearance makes the drug's own half-life a function of the ANC it produced

g.title: cluster_plt
g.text: 9. Platelet lineage — the SAME insult, a different clock (MTT ≈ 200 h)

g.title: cluster_ery
g.text: 10. Erythroid lineage — slowest clock of all, so anaemia is CUMULATIVE across cycles

g.title: cluster_mucosa
g.text: 11. Mucosal barrier injury — the same drug that removes the defence also opens the door

g.title: cluster_infection
g.text: 12. Translocation and infection — a race between bacterial growth and a defence that has been removed

g.title: cluster_fever
g.text: 13. Fever — the readout is inflammation, so a neutropenic patient can be septic and afebrile

g.title: cluster_steroid
g.text: 14. Corticosteroid — the clearest case of the count and the defence moving in opposite directions

g.title: cluster_abx
g.text: 15. Antimicrobials — acting on the pathogen side of the same race

g.title: cluster_endpoints
g.text: 16. Clinical endpoints — note that the driver is the INTEGRAL, not the minimum

g.title: cluster_tumour
g.text: 17. Dose intensity and tumour control — the loop that makes this a decision rather than a toxicity

g.title: cluster_decision
g.text: 18. Decision layer — the 20% threshold is a policy, and the model can be asked where it comes from

g.text: → the day-1 CBC gate passes a
